suite.fairness: Same trajectory IDs per seed/budget, epoch passes, loss and fixed evaluation subsets. Effective batch and per-model overrides are recorded; parameter count and wall time are measured.
suite.baseline_notice: NeRD-like is a controlled local baseline, not official NeRD/FIGNet/RigidFormer.

capacity.notice: Short capacity probe on repeated simulator states; throughput and memory only, not accuracy or convergence. Includes one optimizer update per microbatch; full training accumulates gradients.

resume.scope: Runtime restoration check; not an accuracy experiment
